paragraphs: BBC HomepageSkip to contentAccessibility HelpYour accountHomeNewsSportEarthReelWorklifeTravelCultureFutureMusicTVWeatherSoundsMore menuMore menuSearch BBCHomeNewsSportEarthReelWorklifeTravelCultureFutureMusicTVWeatherSoundsClose menu BBC SportMenuHomeFootballCricketFormula 1Rugby UTennisGolfCyclingAthleticsMoreA-Z SportsAmerican FootballAthleticsBasketballBoxingCricketCyclingDartsDisability SportFootballFormula 1Gaelic GamesGolfGymnasticsHorse RacingMixed Martial ArtsMotorsportNetballRugby LeagueRugby UnionSnookerSwimmingTennisFull Sports A-ZMore from SportEnglandScotlandWalesNorthern IrelandQuizzesNews FeedsHelp & FAQsPremier LeagueScores & FixturesTableFollow Your TeamTransfersTop ScorersGossipMan Utd enquire about Toney - Sunday's gossipPublished1 hour agoManchester United enquire about Ivan Toney's availability, Barcelona are tracking Chelsea winger Estevao Willian, while Jean-Philippe Mateta is set to leave Crystal Palace in January.

Manchester United have enquired about Al-Ahli's 30-year-old England striker Ivan Toney but have ended their interest in Leeds' 29-year-old England forward Dominic Calvert-Lewin. (Caught Offside), external
Barcelona are closely monitoring Chelsea's Brazil winger Estevao Willian with the potential of making a move for the 19-year-old. (Sport - in Spanish) , external
Spain midfielder Fermin Lopez does not want to leave Barcelona amid interest in the 23-year-old from Manchester United and Chelsea. (Fabrizio Romano), external
Japan midfielder Wataru Endo, 33, and Italy winger Federico Chiesa, 29, look certain to leave Liverpool next year. (Echo), external
Crystal Palace's France striker Jean-Philippe Mateta, 29, looks set to leave Selhurst Park in January. (Teamtalk), external

Palace are unsure whether to cash in on Mateta in the winter transfer window or keep him until his contract runs out in the summer, when he will be able to leave the club as a free agent. (Football Insider), external

Arsenal have maintained contact with Real Madrid over Endrick, despite the La Liga giants saying they do not want to let their 20-year-old Brazil forward leave the Bernabeu this season. (Teamtalk), external

Arsenal like Bournemouth's 20-year-old French forward Eli Junior Kroupi, with the Gunners also keeping an eye on Eintracht Frankfurt's 20-year-old Turkey attacking midfielder Can Uzun. (Caught Offside), external
European champions Paris St-Germain are among other clubs monitoring France Under-21 international Kroupi. (Goal), external
Manchester United forward JJ Gabriel is set to leave the club with the 16-year-old Englishman nearing a move to Real Madrid. (Sport - in Spanish), external
Everton will not attempt to sign United States striker Folarin Balogun from Monaco in January after missing out on the 25-year-old in the summer. (Football Insider), external
